measurement_procedure: Cohort aggregate ACTION_RESULT count × log10(cohort_n_agents). Captures the scale-amplified footprint at population level.

threshold_function.concern_direction_semantics: Consumer emits negative-scored attestation when metric is at-or-above threshold_value. Single-pole concern: low values at this axis are not a failure mode (see rationale).
threshold_function.rationale: actions × log10(N) high = population-scale impact concentrated in cohort. Low (small cohort or low-action cohort) is not a failure mode — these are healthy small-scale cohorts.

notes: PROXY: per-act population-scale impact requires affected_population_identifier not in dump. CIRISAgent-side ticket filed.
